methods.formula: Value = (assets in place + C − net debt) ÷ shares;  C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂), d₁ = [ln(S ÷ K) + (r + σ²/2)T] ÷ σ√T, d₂ = d₁ − σ√T
steps: S = the expansion in year 5: the revenue it adds $10.97B (to $16.47B) × margin 29.6% × (1 − tax), as a growing perpetuity, discounted = $37.83B
K = capital to build it: $10.97B ÷ sales-to-capital 0.39 = $28.42B
σ = 50% (its stock, a year of daily closes), T = 5 years, r = 4.91% → C = $21.71B
assets in place = NOPAT $1.23B ÷ WACC = $18.79B; value = ($18.79B + $21.71B − net debt $6.42B) ÷ 240,000,000 = $142.02

methods.formula: Value = D₀ × [(1 + g_L) + H × (g_S − g_L)] ÷ (kₑ − g_L);  growth falls in a straight line from g_S to g_L over 2H years
